llm.guidance: This skill is an instructional guide (no code runs, no credentials requested) and appears internally consistent. Before using any provided code in production: review and audit the code examples, especially sections that interface with smart meters, batteries, or grid controls; ensure legal and regulatory compliance for energy markets in your jurisdiction; secure any real device credentials and use test environments or hardware-in-the-loop before connecting to live systems; and consider third-party security reviews for escrow/settlement and safety-critical control logic.
